summary: A fourth bell rings beneath Faelspire. An impossible black fragment addresses the reader-character and forces a choice among P'taxx, Aard Templu Voreath, and a scarred stray who has heard the bell before.

active_frontiers.title: The Room Behind the Room
active_frontiers.unresolved_pressure: Impossible versions of the reader-character arrive through a room of doors and accuse P'taxx of keeping the wrong book.

active_frontiers.title: Voreath Enters the Shop
active_frontiers.unresolved_pressure: Four impossible points appear around Faelspire, including one above the Royal Palace, and the fragment claims the bell is measuring how long the city takes to look up.

active_frontiers.title: The Thing Below the Courtyard
active_frontiers.unresolved_pressure: A younger version or imitation of the stray climbs from an impossible sky inside a cistern and claims the stray abandoned part of himself.

active_frontiers.title: Twelve Years Ago
active_frontiers.unresolved_pressure: The reader-character's name is written beneath the stray's skin and an unseen presence arrives above Faelspire.
